entities.summary: Jovana Joksimović is a Serbian television presenter, best known for hosting the morning TV show Jutarnji program. In May 2008, together with her, at that time soon to be, husband Željko Joksimović, she was the host of the 53rd edition of Eurovision Song Contest in Belgrade. She now hosts UranaK1 on K1 TV.
